items.title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices
items.excerpt: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max, a new flagship model with 2.4 trillion parameters that activates only 71 billion per token. A hybrid architecture sharply cuts costs on long contexts. Qwen4-Max lands just behind Kimi K3.1 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and Alibaba plans to release smaller Qwen4 models as open source. items.title: Anthropic says the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget, not how much to store
items.excerpt: Anthropic studied how Claude retains knowledge across sessions. Selective notes beat exhaustive archives by a wide margin. In a Pokémon Red test, the newer Claude Fable 5 got four times as far as the older Sonnet 3.7 by keeping just a handful of strategy files instead of more than 400. A "Dreaming" process retroactively corrects faulty memories. The article Anthropic says the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget, not how much to store appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Google warns that fully automated cyberattacks have arrived and will get worse fast
items.excerpt: Google's Threat Intelligence Group has for the first time caught attackers finding and exploiting security vulnerabilities with no human involvement at all. An AI framework called "exploit_agent," found on an exposed server, automatically compared code before and after patches, built exploits, and ran them on its own. The article Google warns that fully automated cyberattacks have arrived and will get worse fast appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
items.excerpt: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to tackle a problem that had stumped particle physicists for over 25 years. The AI model took Craig's strategy for defining the full Standard Model on a computational lattice and turned it into a working proof. Craig says a lot of work remains before realistic simulations are possible.
